headline: Tech investment rises while revenue trends diverge across media, gaming, publishing and education.
summary: Media & Entertainment shows strong top‑line growth and expanding IT spend, led by Disney's 7% revenue rise. Gaming revenue is mixed; Bally's posts 22% growth while Caesars records a net loss. Publishing blends AI rollout with a revenue miss at Scholastic. Education sees AI funding gains but cost cuts at SLU.

industries.summary: Disney posted 7% revenue growth and a 21% jump in operating income. WBD/Skydance and Versant also delivered positive results despite modest margins. Private players Cox and LA Times gave no financial data.

leaders.why: Revenue up 7% to $25.2 bn and operating income up 21%.

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Disney partners with Adobe on generative AI for parks and ESPN; Versant expands digital platforms and adds FAST channels.

themes.title: Digital platform rebuild
themes.detail: Versant grows platform revenue 10% to $245 m and adds new streaming channels.

industries.it_note: IT spend is growing at Disney and Versant, while Cox also expands its digital scheduler.

industries.summary: Bally's revenue jumps 22% YoY, but Caesars posts a widened net loss despite modest revenue growth. Light & Wonder tightens costs, and Brightstar maintains stable margins.

laggards.why: GAAP net loss of $123 m despite $2.94 bn revenue.

themes.title: Digital platform rebuild
themes.detail: Caesars sees digital revenue grow 5%; Bally's expands iGaming and sports betting platforms.

themes.title: AI adoption
themes.detail: Caesars hints AI will augment face‑to‑face meetings, indicating selective use.

themes.title: Cost‑cutting
themes.detail: Light & Wonder prioritises debt reduction and tightens IT spend.

industries.it_note: IT spend is stable at Caesars and Brightstar, tightening at Light & Wonder, and unclear at Bally's.

industries.summary: Pearson shows accelerated revenue growth and expands AI tools, while Scholastic misses revenue and posts a large operating loss. Wolters Kluwer reports neutral performance.

laggards.why: Revenue miss of $216.8 m and operating loss margin -42.5%.

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Pearson rolls out AI‑powered English learning in Thailand; Wolters Kluwer expands Libra AI across Europe.

themes.title: Digital platform rebuild
themes.detail: Pearson launches new Studio suite linking learning, career readiness and credentials.

industries.it_note: Both Pearson and Wolters Kluwer are increasing AI and digital platform investments.
